title: Xdrip sync not updating every 5 min
body: We are using Xdrip sync between the master and a few phones. We also upload to Nightscout. We are finding that Nightscout is reliably updated every 5 min but xdrip sync isn't. Sometimes it's 5 min. Sometimes it's 10 or 15. Nightscout is always 5 though. Thoughts?
